thread:
Sam P: Hey team — quick ask. New contractor Cody starts Monday and needs a guest lab device (MacBook loaner) for the first 2 weeks. Also Cody will be WFH part-time so we need a device policy exception / temporary KMS access? Can security/IT confirm steps?

Cody L: Thanks! I don't have a company laptop yet. I need access to the private test cluster and a yubikey for 2FA. Also wanted to opt out of the phishing sim for a day-only window because I'm in training on Tuesday.

Marta (Manager): Cody will be working on model eval infra — needs access to S3 test buckets (non-prod) and the staging cluster. We can do only non-prod data. No PHI.

Ida (Security): @Marta thanks. A few quick notes:
- Short-term loaner OK but must be MDM-enrolled before network access.
- No KMS key creation/rotation permissions for contractors; we can grant decrypt-only on a restricted keyring for staging via a short-lived role.
- Phishsim: we can put them in the "training-in-progress" exemption for up to 48h, need manager pre-approval.

Kevin (IT): We have a MacBook loaner available. Steps for enrollment: 
1) Fill the loaner request form: https://redwood.internal/it/loaner
2) Bring device to the IT desk at 10am Mon (or we can ship if remote)
3) Run enrollment script or we push MDM automatically.

OnboardBot: Reminder: new hires must complete Security 101 training within 5 business days. Link: https://learn.redwood/sec101 (automated)

Cody L: Marta — can you confirm the manager approval for the phishsim exemption? @Marta (Manager)

Marta (Manager): Approved for 48h exemption for Tuesday-Wednesday while onboarding sessions run. Please add to the exemption list.

Ida (Security): Got it. @Kevin please add Cody L to temporary keyring role "staging-decrypt-temp" expiring 2026-04-06. Also add to phishsim exemption group: phish-exempt-48h.

Kevin (IT): Done. Loaner request submitted and shipping label created. MDM enrollment will be pushed on receipt. I also added a note to ship a YubiKey with the device.

Cody L: Awesome — thanks everyone. Two tiny follow-ups: 
1) How do I SSH into the staging cluster? 
2) Any local dev certs I need to install?

Ida (Security): SSH will be via our bastion host. Use your corp vpn + yubikey (we enabled otp fallback for loaners). I'll DM the bastion host name. For certs: we have a cert bundle at https://redwood.internal/it/dev-certs.pem — IT will push it during MDM enroll.

Kevin (IT): I'll add the bastion entry to /etc/hosts via our MDM profile and push the certs. If you see an enrollment error, run: 

```
sudo profiles renew -type enrollment
```
and ping me.

Sam P: Logging action items — loaner request filled, phishsim exemption approved, temporary key role granted, yubikey shipped. Cody, you'll get OnboardBot checklist and security 101 link. Welcome aboard! :tada:

Cody L: Thanks Sam, and thanks team. I appreciate the quick turnaround. :smile:
